next.reason: 1985: 'Any calling program may call any separately compiled program in the run unit.' 2023: an outermost program's name 'may be referenced by statements included in any source element in the run unit' (§2023:8.4.6.3 SR3), and CALL locates the program by those scope rules (§2023:14.9.4.4 GR3: 'the rules specified in 8.4.6, Scope of names and 8.4.6.3, Scope of program-names, apply'). Functions and methods as callers are 2023-only. Same effect.
